verdict.rationale: Workable can be driven without its UI through a token-authenticated REST API covering jobs, candidates, ratings and members, plus webhook subscriptions and an official MCP server, so scripted, unattended automation is possible. There is no evidence of a CLI, CI integration, or other dedicated headless tooling, so CI automation means hand-rolling API calls. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, published OpenAPI spec for codegen (probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
